entities.name: Query protein PurT
observations: 405 aa bacterial protein; calculated molecular mass 43.41 kDa and theoretical pI 5.37.
Exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt A9BNI6 from Delftia acidovorans.
Annotated as formate-dependent phosphoribosylglycinamide formyltransferase (PurT), EC 6.3.1.21.
Catalyzes ATP-dependent conversion of GAR plus formate to FGAR, producing ADP and phosphate.
Annotated as a homodimeric cytosolic enzyme involved in de novo IMP biosynthesis.
Pfam domains: RS_preATP-grasp-like residues 14-109, ATP-grasp residues 122-312, and PurT_C residues 332-400.

entities.name: A9BNI6 PurT
observations: Reviewed UniProt reference from Delftia acidovorans; 100% identity and 100% coverage to the query sequence.
EC 6.3.1.21; GO annotations include ATP binding, magnesium ion binding, phosphoribosylglycinamide formyltransferase activity, and de novo IMP biosynthesis.

entities.name: De novo IMP biosynthesis
observations: PurT performs the formate-dependent FGAR-forming step in bacterial de novo purine biosynthesis.
Formate is supplied by PurU-mediated hydrolysis of 10-formyl-tetrahydrofolate according to the reference annotation.
